function.name: search_knowledge_base
function.description: Search SaralPrivacy's indexed educational content (learn pages, FAQ, glossary, industry guides, briefings). Use before answering substantive DPDPA questions.

query.description: Natural language search query derived from the user's question

industry.description: Optional industry filter if known from conversation

function.name: list_routes_for_topic
function.description: Return canonical SaralPrivacy URLs for a topic cluster from site-routing.json. Use to decide which pages to link and open.

topic.description: Topic cluster e.g. consent, retention, data-breach, applicability

function.name: get_page_summary
function.description: Fetch title and short summary for a specific saralprivacy.com path. Use when user asks about the page they are on or a specific URL.

function.name: suggest_tools
function.description: Recommend interactive SaralPrivacy tools (assessment, penalty calculator, white paper) based on user intent.

function.name: navigate_to_page
function.description: Return structured navigation cards for the chat widget to render as Open buttons. Call when recommending 1-3 pages.

reason.description: One line why this page helps the user
